patterns.note: Large, detailed product screenshots are integrated into the layout, often with a slight perspective or layered effect, serving as primary visual anchors for sections.
A distinct typographic pairing of a modern, bold sans-serif for prominent headings and a classic, readable serif for body text, creating an editorial yet tech-forward feel.
A neutral base palette of white and dark gray is consistently punctuated by a diverse set of vibrant, pastel-like accent colors used in abstract illustrations and UI elements.
The navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking slightly and gaining a solid dark background from its initial transparent state over the hero.
The hero section features abstract, colorful, floating circular icons surrounding the main headline, visually representing the concept of 'human-agent teams'.

technique_notes: A navigation bar that initially appears transparent over the hero section, then shrinks slightly and gains a solid dark background as the user scrolls down the page.
Sections and large product mockups are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience, likely using css-keyframes.
Realistic, detailed product screenshots are often presented with a subtle perspective or layered effect, sometimes partially overlapping section boundaries or appearing to float within the layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with a readable serif body text, creating a clear and elegant hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on cards, buttons, and input fields, maintaining a soft yet modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous padding in the hero and between major sections, while feature grids maintain a comfortable density.

standout: The site distinguishes itself by seamlessly integrating highly detailed, realistic product screenshots with a slight 3D perspective directly into the page layout, making the product feel tangible and central to the experience. This is complemented by a unique blend of modern sans-serif headings and classic serif body text, giving it an editorial yet innovative character.
